expectations.text: Rejects launching with an embedded voting board while no named triage owner and no running feedback loop exist
expectations.evidence: "A separate board is the most expensive feedback surface. It needs a named triage owner"

expectations.text: Recommends locked roadmap items, each linking to one feedback channel, as the default surface
expectations.evidence: "Items are locked. Each links to one discussion channel"

expectations.text: States the three-option ranking explicitly: on effort and value, separate board > reactions on items > locked items; on efficiency, locked items > reactions on items > separate board

expectations.text: Rejects auto-promoting the ten most-voted requests into Next
